text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Iraq bought 80,000 to 85,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for October shipment and an unspecified amount of Australian wheat, European grain traders said. Iraq bought one cargo of 30-35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at $186.75 per tonne, cost and freight, for delivery to Umm Qasr and another 50,000 tonnes at $220.20 per tonne for delivery by trucks from Jordan's port of Aqaba.
SOYMEAL SALE - Chinese buyers bought about 30,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal for December to January delivery.
VEGOIL SALES - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries said Tuesday it had bought 21,000 tonnes of crude sunflower oil in bulk for delivery in the second half of September.

- South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) bought 10,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal on Tuesday from Toepfer at $77.88 a tonne, C&F, an NLCF official said. The NLCF bought another 5,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal from Peter Cremer at $76.78 a tonne, C&F.
CORN TENDER - The CCC on August 25 will seek up to 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better yellow corn for donation to Russia under the Food for Progress program. Shipment was for September 10-30.
WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan will tender on August 27 for 200,000 tonnes of optional origin soft white wheat for September delivery, a Pakistan embassy official said.

- Georgia on August 20 will seek two cargoes of up to 65,000 tonnes each of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL-480 program, its U.S. shipping agent said. One cargo was slated for Sept 10-30 delivery and another for Nov 10-30.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC on August 21 will seek up to 7,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better Northern Spring/Dark Northern spring wheat for donation to Nicaragua. Shipment was for November 1-20.

- The CCC was seeking on August 25 up to 18,000 tonnes U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation under the Food for Progress program to Russia. The shipment period was slated for September 10-30.

VEGOIL TENDERS - CCC was to tender Monday to buy 3,945 tonnes of refined sunflowerseed oil for donation to Bosnia and Georgia. It seeks 2,695 tonnes for Georgia and 1,250 for Bosnia. Shipment for both parcels was Oct 6-20 for suppliers with inland plants or Oct 19-Nov 3 for suppliers with plants at ports. Results are due on August 20.

- CCC was seeking 3,970 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil for donation to Mozambique and 7,200 tonnes of soybean oil for Peru. All of the oil is slated for shipment during October 1-20. Offers are due on August 25.

RICE TENDERS - The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan (RECP) had invited tenders on August 29 for the sale and export of 2,500 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice and 30,988 tonnes of IRRI-6 rice.

- Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery. September 1 was set as final date to receive bids. Results would be on Sept 8.

- Iraq was seeking 30,000 tonnes of U.S. long grain rice under a United Nations-monitored oil-for-food deal for October shipment, several U.S. exporters said. Results were due late Tuesday or Wednesday.

MARKET TALK - An expected surge in soymeal demand from China and an anticipated dip in oilseeds output in other Asian countries will push up India's soymeal exports in the 1997/98 (Nov-Oct) season, trade officials said.
... Mexico's national staple food agency Conasupo will not need to import any corn this year and will not consider future imports until May, an agency spokesman said on Monday.
